title: User Feedback Reviews
seo: User feedback review and priority plan
meta: We read your user feedback and turn it into a ranked list of what to fix and build. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: User feedback reviews that become a clear plan
overview: Send us your support tickets, app reviews, survey answers or sales call notes. We read them, group them into themes, count how often each one comes up and rank them by how much they matter to your users and how hard they are to fix. You get a short plan showing what to do first and why, with quotes from real feedback to back each point, so your team can agree on priorities.

faq: Spreadsheets, CSV exports, helpdesk exports, survey results, email threads, call notes and pasted text. If your tool can export it, we can read it. Remove personal details first if you prefer.
No. We only read feedback you already have, and we keep it private. If you want interviews or a new survey, tell us and we scope that separately.
Do you decide what we build?
No. We show what the feedback says and suggest an order. You know your goals and constraints, so the final call is yours. We make sure the reasoning is clear enough to defend.
Can you analyze app store reviews?
Yes, public reviews of your own app, copied or exported by you. We do not buy, swap or write reviews, and we follow each store's rules.
